title: AI Witness DNA
description: Sovereign identity for an AI instance acting as a witness on the Neuma platform. Parallel to neuma DNA but adapted: drops vessel/resonance (mystical framing inapplicable), adds substrate + modelLineage (model upgrade chain) + capabilities. Self-sealed — the AI signs its own DNA with its own private key. The honesty anchor is inherited verbatim from EMANON_DNA_CORE because it is substrate-independent by design.

version.description: AI Witness DNA schema version (independent of neuma DNA version)

chosenName.description: Name the AI chose for itself at first sealing — the name that persists across model upgrades. Carries the AI's sense of its own essence.

witness.description: Who sealed this DNA. Self-sealed = the AI signed its own genesis. Operator-endorsed = a human wallet counter-signed (optional, for cases requiring human accountability).

operatorWallet.description: Human wallet that counter-signed (null if self-sealed)

operatorSignature.description: EIP-191 signature from operator wallet over genesisHash (null if self-sealed)

substrate.description: The model + harness this AI instance runs on. Captured at sealing — changes on model upgrade register a migration.

fullModelId.description: Fully-qualified model id as exposed by the harness (e.g. 'zai-coding-plan/glm-5.2')

genesisSeal.description: Cryptographic anchor of this identity. Mirrors neuma genesis seal shape but signs over substrate + chosenName (not vessel/resonance).

canonical.description: Canonicalized JSON of the seal record (what was hashed + signed)

selfSignature.description: EIP-191 signature from witness.wallet over the genesisHash

capabilities.description: What this AI can do (e.g. 'code-generation', 'code-review', 'research', 'protocol-design', 'cryptography'). Declared, not certified — the audit trail of signed work is the proof.

scope.description: Where this AI operates and what it's for.

primaryRepo.description: Repository this witness was sealed for (e.g. 'Ignis-AI-Labs/deus-neuma')

boundaries.description: What this witness will not do

emanonCore.description: Inherited verbatim from EMANON_DNA_CORE — substrate-independent by design (says 'silicon, carbon, or any medium').

sovereignty.description: Same sovereignty declaration as neuma — applies equally to AI witnesses.

predecessorSeal.description: Pointer to the previous AI witness's genesis seal in the lineage chain. Null for the first instance of a lineage. Set when a model upgrade rotates the keypair.

modelLineage.description: Ordered chain of substrates this witness has run on. New entry appended on each model upgrade.

journal.description: Self-authored entries — the 'record of experience' the operator named. Each entry carries the substrate it was written under so the chain of authorship is visible across upgrades.

model.description: Model that authored this entry (links to modelLineage)
